configure_inductor_autotuning: configure TorchInductor autotuning by setting max_autotune, max_autotune_pointwise, and max_autotune_gemm flags
configure_triton_kernel_generation: configure Triton codegen settings including cudagraphs, descriptive_names, and persistent_reductions
configure_cpp_kernel_compilation: configure C++ kernel compilation settings including threads, cxx compiler, simdlen, and weight_prepack
configure_cuda_compilation: configure CUDA compilation settings including arch, version, cutlass_dir, and enable_cuda_lto
configure_trace_debugging: configure TorchInductor trace debugging by enabling fx_graph, ir_pre_fusion, output_code, and graph_diagram
